# Third-party notices

## J2ME-Loader

This project embeds and adapts the J2ME-Loader Android runtime. Its upstream project is available at https://github.com/nikita36078/J2ME-Loader and is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The full upstream license text is retained in `LICENSE`.

## TinySoundFont

The upstream J2ME-Loader project declares TinySoundFont as a Git submodule at `app/src/main/cpp/mmapi_tsf/TinySoundFont`. The source ZIP supplied for this work contained an empty submodule directory. Restore it with `scripts/restore_tinysoundfont.ps1` (Windows) or `scripts/restore_tinysoundfont.sh` (Linux/macOS). TinySoundFont's upstream project is https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont and is licensed under MIT; retain its `LICENSE` and copyright notice alongside the source.

## Meteor Café

The bundled JAR is an original third-party game file supplied for private preservation and compatibility work. The JAR identifies the MIDlet as MeteorCafe version 1.18.0. Internal credits identify THQ and 3 Dynamics (Asia) Limited. This project does not claim ownership of the game or grant redistribution rights.
